g.text: Both arms use ground-aware association, identical sensor budgets and the same numerical surface metric.
Saved paths and headings; no smoothing. Open circles mark turns. † Original unqualified status remains retained.
Missing/running/failed conditions are labelled explicitly; no path or score is inferred for them.
